name: eevee-motion-blur-velocity-direction
purpose: Verify Eevee motion blur uses the correct object velocity buffers for ordinary moving objects and does not smear static objects or background pixels.
passCriteria: A synthetic scene with one static object and one horizontally animated object must show motion-blur differences only around the moving object. The static object and background regions must remain nearly identical between motion-blur on/off renders, while the moving-object region must contain a clear blur footprint.
